scope: SLC43 tree with more b-side taxa added to break a short internal branch. A gene tree places sequences; it does not prove orthology.
why: With a full-length zebrafish slc43a2a in the tree, flying-fish slc43locus02 pairs with it rather than with slc43a2b -- but at only 36.2/65 support, which is not a claim. Adding slc43a2b from two more percomorphs gives the b-side clade more structure, so an a-side locus should stand out if it is one.
question: With Takifugu and stickleback slc43a2b added, does slc43locus02 still sit with zebrafish slc43a2a, and at what support?
note_on_annotation: Only zebrafish has an annotated slc43a2a; Ensembl lists slc43a2b and NO slc43a2a for Takifugu, stickleback and medaka. That is the same pattern seen for kcnh2a, and it is an annotation fact, not a genome-content proof.
